bug.description: With a malformed row in alert_rules (skipped with a warning at startup), GET /api/rules returns 503 "rule storage unavailable" permanently, because Database.list_rules builds Rule objects without the skip logic and ValidationError propagates. The app starts but the rules endpoint is unusable until the row is removed by hand. The implementer flagged this as out of scope; the verification request expects GET /api/rules to return only valid rules.
bug.reproduction: Throwaway PG with schema created, then: INSERT INTO alert_rules VALUES ('bad1','TSLA','price_above',-1,NULL,2), ('ok1','AAPL','price_above',100,NULL,1); start uvicorn app.main:app with that DATABASE_URL; curl http://127.0.0.1:PORT/api/rules -> 503; log "app.routers.rules: rule list failed: ValidationError".

bug.description: Error-text scrubbing replaces every occurrence of the password string, so a short password corrupts the logged message (password "x": 'database "nodb_zz" does not e***ist'). No secret leaks; message readability suffers only with very short passwords.
bug.reproduction: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:x@127.0.0.1:PORT/nodb_zz; start the server; see the "does not e***ist" in the app.db and app.main lines.
